description: Natural terracotta octagon tile in an 8x8 inch size from Pak Clay. The eight-sided shape makes the floor itself the pattern, especially when small squares or dots fill the gaps between pieces. Fired clay gives a warm, earthy colour with slight shade variation from piece to piece. It suits living rooms, verandas and courtyards on a level base. Clay is porous, so ask your fixer about a breathable sealer and order extra from one batch for cuts. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Natural terracotta square tile, 12x12 inch, from Pak Clay, listed for outdoor use. The large format means fewer joints on porches, terraces and garden paths, and gives a warm clay colour that suits both traditional and modern houses. Shade varies a little between pieces, so compare against your walls in daylight. Lay it on a sound, sloped-to-drain base, and ask your fixer about sealing, since clay is porous. Order the full quantity together. Request a free sample on WhatsApp with your area, use and city for a dated written quote.
